mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If UNRATE exceeds 10% but S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth is strong but UNRATE remains high, it indicates inefficiencies in labor utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as productivity concerns arise.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE show the described pattern but S&P 500 returns are positive in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS increases borrowing costs, reducing corporate investments and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is rising but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 60% of cases during the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL indicates inflationary pressures, leading to potential rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns as equity valuations are compressed.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO without corresponding growth in RSAFS suggests supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as production costs rise.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases without RSAFS growth but S&P 500 returns are positive in over 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in HOUST below 500 indicates weak housing demand, signaling broader economic weakness and leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If HOUST falls below 500 but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion, increasing GDPC1 reflects economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of early-cycle cases.
